security.output:
The diff introduces an off-by-one in a bounds check. `i > len(xs)` allows `i == len(xs)`, so the subsequent `xs[i]` access panics with index out of range on any slice when the caller passes `i == len(xs)` — previously that input returned `(0, false)`. This is a concrete denial-of-service / logic defect reachable with attacker-controlled index if the caller passes user input.
